# Belt Shakers

\\nThe Belt shaker is made from seed pods and makes a beautiful watery sound when worn by a dancer or used as a shaker! They can be worn on the ankles or the wrists and attaches easily using a velcro strip sewn onto kente cloth. The seed pods have a wonderful texture and what we would call a [loud sound for a shaker.](/product/beaded-shaker/) \\n \\nMade in Ghana, West Africa. \\n \\nNB: Items may vary slightly in appearance from that pictured. Please contact us if you have any questions.
